parts.label: Sun
parts.note: Lights and warms the side of the Earth facing it

parts.label: Tilted axis
parts.note: Leans 23.5 degrees and always points the same way

parts.label: June
parts.note: North tipped towards the Sun: northern summer

parts.label: March equinox
parts.note: Neither half tipped to the Sun: day equals night

parts.label: September equinox
parts.note: Day and night are the same length again

parts.label: Orbit
parts.note: One trip round the Sun takes a year
